description: Xero Quotes and BrandingThemes (Templates) API - Create, manage, and retrieve sales quotes with template/branding assignment. Quotes are estimates/proposals that can be converted to invoices.

tools.name: xero_create_quote
tools.short_description: Create new Xero sales quote with line items, contact, and optional branding theme
tools.description: Create a new sales quote in Xero with optional branding theme (template) assignment. Use this to generate professional quote documents for customers. Quotes can include line items, pricing, terms, and expiry dates. Returns the created quote with QuoteID for tracking.

business_id.description: Business ID (1=InHouse Print, 2=Publishing, 3=Signs) - Required to identify which Xero organization

contact_id.description: Xero contact ID (use xero_get_contacts to find). The customer/client receiving this quote - Required

line_items.description: Array of quote line items with description, quantity, unit_amount, and optional account_code - Required

branding_theme_id.description: BrandingThemeID from xero_get_branding_themes. Assigns template/logo/styling to quote. Optional - uses default if not provided. Use this if you have the exact GUID.

template_name.description: Template name (e.g., 'Default Theme', 'Standard Invoice'). Automatically looks up the BrandingThemeID. Use this instead of branding_theme_id if you know the template name. Optional - uses default if not provided.

date.description: Quote issue date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Optional - defaults to today

expiry_date.description: Quote expiry date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Optional - quote validity period

title.description: Quote title text (max 100 chars). Optional - appears at top of quote

summary.description: Quote summary text (max 3000 chars). Optional - additional notes/description

terms.description: Terms and conditions text (max 4000 chars). Optional

reference.description: Additional reference number (max 4000 chars). Optional - your internal reference

returns.description: Created quote with QuoteID, QuoteNumber, Status (DRAFT), contact info, line items, totals, and URL

examples.description: Create quote with branding theme for printing services

parameters.title: Business Card Printing Quote
parameters.terms: 50% deposit required. Balance due on completion.

examples.description: Create quote using template_name (easier than branding_theme_id)

parameters.title: Professional Printing Services Quote
parameters.summary: Thank you for your interest in our professional printing services.
parameters.terms: Payment due within 30 days. 50% deposit required to commence production.

workflow_example.name: Complete Quote Creation and Email Workflow
workflow_example.description: 5-step workflow to create a branded quote and send it via draft email

steps.purpose: Find the customer who will receive the quote
steps.output: Returns contact_id, name, and email address needed for quote and email

steps.purpose: List available quote templates (OPTIONAL - can skip if OAuth scope missing)
steps.note: ⚠️ Requires 'accounting.settings.read' OAuth scope. If missing, use template_name parameter instead

steps.purpose: Create the quote with line items and selected template
steps.example: xero_create_quote(business_id=1, contact_id='abc-123', line_items=[...], template_name='Standard Invoice', title='Printing Quote', expiry_date='2025-12-31')
steps.output: Returns quote_id, quote_number, total, and status (DRAFT)

steps.purpose: Get complete quote details including PDF download URL
steps.output: Returns full quote with pdf_url field for downloading quote PDF

steps.purpose: Create draft email with quote information or PDF attachment
steps.output: Creates draft email in Outlook Drafts folder (NOT sent automatically)
steps.note: ⚠️ Email saved as DRAFT - user must manually send from Outlook

important_notes: 📧 outlook_send_email creates DRAFTS only - user must send manually from Outlook
📄 PDF attachments must be base64 encoded in 'content' field
✅ Use template_name parameter for easier template selection (auto-lookup)
💡 Quote PDF URLs expire - download immediately if attaching to email
🎨 Branding themes control logo, colors, fonts on quote PDFs
🔄 Account code '200' is standard for Sales/Revenue

alternative_approaches.without_template: Omit both template_name and branding_theme_id - Xero will use default styling
alternative_approaches.email_with_link: Instead of PDF attachment, include quote link in email body: 'View Quote'
alternative_approaches.skip_branding_themes: If OAuth scope missing, skip step 2 and use template_name='Standard Invoice' in step 3

tools.name: xero_list_quotes
tools.short_description: List Xero quotes with mandatory date range filters (70,000+ quotes requires date filtering)
tools.description: Retrieve quotes from Xero with advanced filtering and pagination. ⚠️ CRITICAL: With 70,000+ quotes, you MUST use date_from/date_to filters to prevent token overflow! MANDATORY filters: date_from + date_to (use last 30-90 days). Optional filters: contact_id, status, quote_number. Use pagination for large result sets. Returns quotes with contact info, line items, totals, and status.

date_from.description: ⚠️ MANDATORY: Filter quotes from this date (YYYY-MM-DD format). REQUIRED with 70,000+ quotes to prevent token overflow. Filters by Quote Date. Use recent date ranges (last 30-90 days) or specific periods.

date_to.description: ⚠️ MANDATORY: Filter quotes to this date (YYYY-MM-DD format). REQUIRED with 70,000+ quotes to prevent token overflow. Filters by Quote Date. Use with date_from to create specific date range.

contact_id.description: Filter by specific Xero contact ID. Useful to see all quotes for one customer.

status.description: Filter by quote status. Options: DRAFT, SENT, DECLINED, ACCEPTED, INVOICED, DELETED. Useful to find quotes awaiting action.

quote_number.description: Filter by specific quote number. Exact match search.

page.description: Page number for pagination (default: 1). CRITICAL with 70,000+ quotes - use pagination!

page_size.description: Number of records per page (default: 100, max: 100). With 70,000 quotes, fetching all is impractical.

returns.description: Paginated list of quotes with pagination metadata (total_count, page, page_size), quotes array with QuoteID, QuoteNumber, Contact, LineItems, Status, Total, Date, ExpiryDate

examples.description: Get recent quotes for last 30 days (recommended approach)
Get all DRAFT quotes awaiting approval
Get all quotes for specific customer

tools.name: xero_get_quote_by_id
tools.short_description: Get specific Xero quote by QuoteID with line items, totals, and PDF URL
tools.description: Retrieve a specific quote by QuoteID. Use this to get complete quote details including all line items, contact information, pricing breakdown, branding theme, status, and PDF URL. Returns full quote object.

returns.description: Complete quote object with QuoteID, QuoteNumber, Contact, LineItems (with descriptions, quantities, prices), Status, SubTotal, TotalTax, Total, Date, ExpiryDate, BrandingThemeID, Terms, Reference, Title, Summary

examples.description: Get quote after creation to obtain PDF URL for email attachment
examples.usage_note: After creating a quote with xero_create_quote, use this to get the pdf_url field for downloading and attaching to emails

workflow_context.typical_usage: Called after xero_create_quote to retrieve complete quote details including PDF download URL
workflow_context.common_workflow: Step 4 of 5 in Quote Creation + Email workflow
key_returned_fields: pdf_url - URL to download quote PDF (requires authentication, expires quickly)
quote_number - Human-readable quote number (e.g., QU-0123) for email subject
total - Total amount for displaying in email body
line_items - Full list with descriptions, quantities, prices for email details
contact.email - Customer email address for sending quote
important_notes: 💡 PDF URLs expire quickly - download immediately if attaching to email
📧 Use quote_number and total in email subject/body for professional communication
🔗 PDF URL requires Xero OAuth authentication to download

tools.name: xero_update_quote
tools.short_description: Update existing Xero quote with new line items, status, or branding theme
tools.description: Update an existing quote in Xero. Use this to modify quote details, add/remove line items, change branding theme, update status (e.g., mark as SENT, ACCEPTED), or adjust pricing. Can update any editable fields including contact, line items, dates, terms, and branding.

quote_id.description: Xero QuoteID to update (GUID format) - Required

contact_id.description: Update contact ID. Optional - only if changing customer

line_items.description: Updated array of line items. Optional - replaces all existing line items if provided

status.description: Update quote status. Options: DRAFT, SENT, DECLINED, ACCEPTED. Note: INVOICED status set automatically when converted to invoice.

returns.description: Updated quote object with all current values

examples.description: Mark quote as SENT after emailing to customer
Update quote with new line items and branding

tools.name: xero_get_branding_themes
tools.short_description: List all Xero branding themes (templates) with IDs, names, and logo URLs
tools.description: Retrieve all available branding themes (templates) from Xero. Branding themes control the logo, colors, and layout of quotes and invoices. Use this to find BrandingThemeID values for assigning templates when creating/updating quotes. Returns theme ID, name, logo URL, and sort order (default theme has sort_order=0).

returns.description: Array of branding themes with BrandingThemeID, Name, LogoUrl, Type (INVOICE), SortOrder (0=default), CreatedDateUTC

examples.description: List templates before creating quote to select professional branding
examples.usage_note: Use returned branding_theme_id or name when calling xero_create_quote to apply logo and styling

workflow_context.typical_usage: Called before xero_create_quote to discover available templates and select appropriate branding
workflow_context.common_workflow: Step 2 of 5 in Quote Creation + Email workflow (OPTIONAL STEP)
workflow_context.oauth_requirement: ⚠️ Requires 'accounting.settings.read' OAuth scope - if missing, you'll get 401 Unauthorized
workflow_context.fallback_approach: If OAuth scope is missing, skip this step and use template_name='Standard Invoice' parameter in xero_create_quote instead
key_returned_fields: branding_theme_id - GUID for use in xero_create_quote branding_theme_id parameter
name - Template name for use in xero_create_quote template_name parameter (easier)
logo_url - URL to preview template logo
usage_options: Option B: Use template name (easier) - xero_create_quote(template_name='Standard Invoice')
Option C: Skip this tool entirely and let Xero use default styling
important_notes: 🔐 OAuth scope 'accounting.settings.read' is REQUIRED for this endpoint
✅ template_name parameter in xero_create_quote is easier than using branding_theme_id
🎨 Branding themes control logo, colors, fonts, and layout on quote PDFs
💡 If this tool fails with 401, use template_name='Standard Invoice' as fallback
